tool_calls.name: universe_describe
tool_calls.result_text:
v_workcell
  workcell_id (BIGINT): The one id for a workcell. Every other table joins on this, never on a name.
  workcell (VARCHAR): Workcell = CUSTOMER — the customer-dedicated production organisation (e.g. KEYSIGHT, WABTEC). Not a station, not a cell on a line.
  entity_type (VARCHAR): customer = a normal customer workcell · shared_line = an internal line many customers use (AOP runs SMT for others) · support = has people, builds nothing (WAREHOUSE) · unknown = the row scans land on when no customer resolves.
  status (VARCHAR): active or inactive in the August 2026 registry. 'How many workcells' has several true answers — say which filter you used.
  plant_physical (VARCHAR): Where the workcell physically sits: P1, P2 or BK (Batu Kawan). MICRON SIG, LAMGB, LAMMEC sit in BK.
  plant_governing (VARCHAR): Which plant supervises it. Differs from plant_physical for MICRON SIG, LAMGB, LAMMEC (BK floor, Plant 1 supervision). 'In P1' is two questions — ask which.
  region (VARCHAR): Penang Island (P1 + P2) or Batu Kawan, following the physical plant.
  division (VARCHAR): MES division text, an attribute of the workcell, not a level above it.
  mes_customer_id (DOUBLE): The primary MES Customer_ID. Some workcells hold two (KEYSIGHT is 7 and 114) — the full set is in workcell_alias.
  parent_proposed (VARCHAR): The parent workcell the August registry PROPOSED (KEYSIGHT for K_CTEC …). Families are not yet a confirmed fact; do not roll up on this without saying so.
  confidence (VARCHAR): extracted = seen in source data · guess = inferred by the August registry build · n/a = synthetic row.

tool_calls.name: universe_describe
tool_calls.result_text:
v_process
  process_id (BIGINT): The key of one process at the ALIAS level — the thing a cycle time sits on.
  alias (VARCHAR): IEDB alias — the specific variant, e.g. 'HLA (CPU) 1'. This is the identity (case 16).
  process_kind (VARCHAR): IEDB process — the kind of work above the alias, e.g. 'Assembly 1' (266 kinds).
  name (VARCHAR): Display name.
  work_kind (VARCHAR): manual · machine · mixed — who does the work.
  workcenter (VARCHAR): SMT · TH · BE — the process STAGE (not geography; 'area' means geography elsewhere).
  workcenter_type (VARCHAR): Finer stage label (HLA is a kind of BE).
  mes_steps (VARCHAR): The MES step names this process scans at, when mapped.
  models (BIGINT): How many models use this process (registry count).
  lines (BIGINT): How many lines run it.
  customers (BIGINT): How many workcells use it.
  avg_sec (DOUBLE): Average study cycle time across uses, seconds — orientation only; the studies are in v_cycle_time.

tool_calls.name: universe_describe
tool_calls.result_text:
v_cycle_time
  workcell (VARCHAR): Workcell = customer.
  workcell_id (BIGINT): Join key to v_workcell.
  assembly (VARCHAR): Part number = model = assembly.
  model_id (BIGINT): Join key to dim_model.
  revision (VARCHAR): The revision this study is for. Standards are per revision; a new revision does NOT automatically inherit (open question).
  line_id (VARCHAR): The line (sub-workcenter) the route runs on — IEDB only.
  step_order (INTEGER): Position of the step on the route.
  alias (VARCHAR): The process alias — the identity the time sits on.
  process_kind (VARCHAR): The kind of work (IEDB process).
  workcenter (VARCHAR): SMT · TH · BE stage.
  cycle_time_sec (DOUBLE): The STANDARD: stopwatch work content per unit, seconds, from an IE time study. Never an elapsed time — that is fact_cycle_time_measured.
  mach_sec (DOUBLE): Machine time component.
  imt_sec (DOUBLE): Operator-at-machine component.
  hand_sec (DOUBLE): Pure hand time component.
  headcount (DOUBLE): Operators at the step.
  parallel_cap (DOUBLE): Parallel capacity within ONE study row (panel-up). NOT machines available.
  fpy (DOUBLE): First-pass yield assumed by the study.
  ct_status (VARCHAR): measured = a study with a time · missing = the step exists in IEDB with no time. Absence is a value (case 41).
  updated_on (VARCHAR): When IEDB last touched the row.
  study_id (BIGINT): The IEDB row id — studies are append-only events.

    *   The `BURN IN 1` process is the overwhelming driver of the cycle time for model `P5000-62202`.
    *   The `ESS 1` and `TEST (ADJ) 1` processes are also significantly high compared to standard test processes seen in other models.

    *   *Burn-In:* 688,800 seconds is roughly 191 hours. This is a long-duration soak test. Improvement would involve parallelization or reducing the soak time if validated.
